about: The Snap gate's local fixtures (SNAP_TEST_FIXTURES): pictures, clips and data from the study's private work, kept out of the repo. A suite names a file by this path under that folder. The critic's fixtures have their own manifest (critic/fixtures.json, SNAP_CRITIC_FIXTURES).

groups.e2e_refs3_00001_.mp4: a short upscaled clip with sound, the take test_g2_polish.js plays
groups.gate_accounts.json: passwords of the gatetest install's accounts (admin, member, kid, newkid, newkid2), made for that local install
groups.gpubase: U56b frames and their face masks (identity notes) and the set card test_world.js compares with, from a GPU test base
groups.id_copy: the identity/copy scout's fixtures: short03 Cast and village pictures with head boxes and its results (G1b notes)
groups.old_snap_workflow_u19.json: a workflow an early Snap saved (U19), for the compat suite
groups.person_seed.json: the operator's person-layer notes, seeded as instruction records by the agent library suite
groups.short03: the anime dogfood short03 village: master, set plans, camera map, plates (settei_bg) and voice references
groups.short04: the anime dogfood short04 'Leaf Day': two Casts' fronts (and one back), the shrine's master and P1 plate, two picked boards and two picked cuts (the Book suites)
groups.u102b_orbit_prompt.json: an orbit-turnaround prompt in API form, for the stage 2 suites
groups.u32: eyes fixtures: day/night frames, crops, masks and a day take (U32)
groups.u49: a copy candidate and a new-view candidate of the U21 plate (U49)
groups.u56b: U56b hair metrics the identity notes are checked against
groups.u59: four scene takes, day and night (U59)
groups.u61: identity looks per frame (test_identity_notes.py writes a fresh copy to the output folder's u61/)
groups.voice_timbre: the voice timbre scout's clips, embeddings and rounds (G1b voice note)
groups.short05: the anime dogfood short05 'One More Bowl': the live C2 board s9221 (Kuroe in spectacles, the critic's finding F-Q20) the G9 Room suite shows
groups.g14: real region edits cropped to the box and 24 px around it (picture and pasted box), with each box's place and feather (seam_cases.json), and fix B s9912's Picture 1, edit and two stage 2 redraws around the head (G14 seam tone and keep-edit suites)
groups.seq02_bakeoff: the anime dogfood seq02 dials bake-off: the dramatic-light clash w05 (take-7eb0036f: its clip, its take record with the graph that ran, and the frame-46 crop the continuity insert used), test_g17_dials.js and test_g17_export.js
